overnight_scope: New evolutions and other special forms
quality_bar: Compare every approval candidate against native Platinum/HGSS battle sprite readability, silhouette, outline, palette discipline, front/back consistency, and DS-scale framing.
current_hour_action: Locked dedupe/quality pipeline so later passes classify the 1,098 rough special-form rows consistently and avoid wasting redraw effort on recoverable or duplicate assets.

pipeline.tier_0: Native Platinum/HGSS comparison reference; never replace.
pipeline.tier_1: Official/canon later-generation forms: source-match first; convert without reinterpretation.
pipeline.tier_2: Community sprites with complete front/back + provenance: polish/normalize.
pipeline.tier_3: Community sprites missing one component: repair only missing component; preserve original design.
pipeline.tier_4: Degraded conversion but recoverable original: recover original before any redraw.
pipeline.tier_5: No viable source: redraw to DS quality; hold subjective design changes for approval.

blocker_policy: Ordinary technical conversion/integration blockers may be resolved automatically. Subjective redesigns remain flagged NEEDS_ART_APPROVAL.
